network_stats.schema_note: Spec name not found; using realized name 'network_validation_report.json'. Top keys: ['git_sha', 'timestamp', 'proxy', 'proxy_description', 'generator', 'params', 'generated', 'checks', 'all_non_range_passed']

giant_component_fraction.target_source: Buchanan R et al. J Infect 80:225 (2019). DOI 10.1016/j.jinf.2019.12.010 (137/595 in giant, ~23–100%); Klovdahl/Potterat 1994. Minimum ~45% as operationally relevant connected component.
giant_component_fraction.note: Current dyad model: ~29% — fails this check; Handoff 7A connectivity fix expected to raise this.

clustering_coefficient.target_source: Rolls DA et al. J Theor Biol 297:73 (2011). DOI 10.1016/j.jtbi.2011.12.008; Buchanan 2019.
clustering_coefficient.note: ABOVE_FLOOR (~0.08) currently; Proxy C first to reach PASS.

mean_path_length.target_source: Klovdahl AS, Potterat JJ et al. Soc Sci Med 38:79 (1994). DOI 10.1016/0277-9536(94)90302-6
mean_path_length.note: Target ~3.1 (small-world injection-network core). Range [2.5, 4.5] is two-sided so both stale-long (≥5) and dyad-short (≤2.3) register as FAIL.

dispersion_k2_over_k2.target_source: Buchanan 2019 — max degree 14 vs mean 2.6 implies heavy tail substantially above Poisson (1 + 1/⟨k⟩).
dispersion_k2_over_k2.note: Poisson baseline = 1 + 1/⟨k⟩ computed from the SAME RUN's ⟨k⟩ (not hardcoded) so the target moves correctly when 7A reconnects isolates. Target = baseline × 1.5.

hiv_r0.note: HIV forward prediction — reported here, NEVER scored.
